nodes.rationale: Gesture only acts after ~0.5 s hold, otherwise freehand underline/hatching would be impossible.

nodes.label: iOS ProMotion frame rate request while drawing
nodes.rationale: 80-120 Hz only while the pen is down, released when idle; iPhone needs CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone in Info.plist or it is capped at 60 Hz.

nodes.label: iOS scrolling note header (EditorView.headerView)
nodes.rationale: Cover, title and metadata scroll with the text; text starts below; height re-measured on rotation and Dynamic Type; strokes and margin notes follow the text; pen does not draw on the header.
